mapper.select: SELECT R.REQ_NO, R.EMP_NO, E.EMP_NM, R.REQ_TYPE, R.REQ_AMT, R.STATUS FROM TB_WELFARE_REQ R JOIN TB_EMP E ON E.EMP_NO = R.EMP_NO WHERE 1 = 1 AND E.EMP_NM LIKE '%' || #{EMP_NM} || '%' AND R.REQ_TYPE = #{REQ_TYPE} AND R.REQ_DT >= TO_DATE(#{FROM_DT}, 'YYYYMMDD') ORDER BY R.REQ_NO DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_WELFARE_REQ (REQ_NO, EMP_NO, REQ_TYPE, REQ_AMT, STATUS, REQ_DT) VALUES (SEQ_WELFARE_REQ.NEXTVAL, #{EMP_NO}, #{REQ_TYPE}, #{REQ_AMT}, 'REQ', SYSDATE)
INSERT INTO TB_WELFARE_REQ_HIST (REQ_NO, CHG_DT, ROW_STATUS, REQ_AMT) SELECT REQ_NO, SYSDATE, #{rowStatus}, REQ_AMT FROM TB_WELFARE_REQ WHERE REQ_NO = #{REQ_NO}
